Subject: ShieldBridge connector & evidence exchange - quick intro

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. ShieldBridge would like to propose a lightweight connector to push SOC2/pentest artifacts into Redwood's evidence intake for partner integrations. We have a short whitepaper attached that outlines our delivery model, retention controls, and artifact schema.

High level asks from our side:
- A transient S3 (or secure POST) endpoint for artifact drops (we support signed uploads).
- A mapping table you can share for artifact types/metadata (timestamp, test-run-id, control-id).
- A contact at Redwood for periodic attestation and a stub to exchange hashes for integrity verification.

We often work with PenVerify for coordinated pen tests; ops@penverify.io will run the scan and hand off artifacts. If Redwood has any special formats or redaction requirements we can adapt.

Attaching: SB-connector-whitepaper.pdf

Would you be able to set a week for an intake call this month? If helpful I can include our technical PM and our pen-test partner.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Partnerships Lead, ShieldBridge
anna@shieldbridge.com

Anna — thanks for the note and the whitepaper. A few items from our side to determine onboarding scope:

1) Technical intake
- We prefer S3 presigned uploads for larger artifacts and a secure POST for small JSON manifests. Can you confirm ShieldBridge can sign uploads or support presigned workflows?
- Artifact schema: provide expected MIME types and a sample payload for test-run metadata. We need control-id, test-run-id, sha256, and timestamp.

2) Security & privacy
- Retention: Redwood keeps partner-submitted artifacts by default for 90 days; beyond that we can tier to cold storage with customer opt-in. Do you need a longer retention for audit purposes?
- Access: who at ShieldBridge and PenVerify needs access to the intake logs (list emails).

3) Legal / procurement
- We'll want a limited SOW that covers data handling and redaction responsibilities before we enable automatic ingestion. Is your legal team able to sign a connector SOW + DPA?

4) Pen test coordination
- If PenVerify will run scans, please loop them in and provide a sample scope spreadsheet (desc of assets, test windows, expected artifact types). We will need to schedule an intake call to align on ACLs and any proxying we require.

If you can answer these and share the sample artifact payload + any internal contacts for PenVerify, we can get a kickoff scheduled for the week of June 26.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Partner Security Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachment reference: shieldbridge-evidence-spec-v1.docx)

From: Anna Li <anna@shieldbridge.com>

Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ShieldBridge connector & evidence exchange - intake questions

Hi Kimberly — appreciate the detailed checklist. Quick answers below and I've attached our integration checklist with examples.

1) Uploads
- We support both presigned S3 and HTTPS signed POSTs. We can use presigned for larger archive bundles and POST for small JSON manifests.

2) Schema
- Attached is a sample payload and a MIME map. We send: control_id, test_run_id, artifact_type, sha256, timestamp, origin_system. Artifact types: raw-report.pdf, raw-logs.tar.gz, trimmed-report.json (redacted), evidence-hash.txt.

3) Retention
- ShieldBridge stores a copy for 365 days by default for customer audit, but we can set a custom TTL per-integration. We can mark artifacts as "redwood-only" so ShieldBridge doesn't keep a second copy if Redwood requests.

4) DPA/SOW
- Legal is fine to sign our connector SOW; I'll loop in our counsel if/when you send a draft.

5) PenVerify
- Looping PenVerify ops here (ops@penverify.io). They will provide the scope sheet and an ops contact.

Attached: integration-checklist.xlsx

Would June 27, 10:00 PT be a good time for an intake call?

Best,
Anna Li
Partnerships Lead, ShieldBridge

(attachment: integration-checklist.xlsx)

Hi Anna / PenVerify team — thanks for looping us in. A couple of compliance items before we confirm the intake window: 

- We require a pen-test scope spreadsheet with asset inventory and planned test windows (please include network ranges/hostnames and whether social engineering is included). The PenVerify sample will be fine; attach it to the ticket.
- For SOC2 evidence we need artifact-level redaction guidance. If ShieldBridge produces raw reports containing customer-identifiable data, we require either (a) a redacted trimmed-report.json or (b) a redaction manifest we can apply.
- Please provide the expected maximum artifact size per test-run (so we can provision ingestion throughput).
- Procurement note: StormApps security (included) will validate whether DPA + SOW templates can be completed prior to ingestion. Please expect a short review by their legal/procurement.

Attaching a template we prefer for pen-test scope: penverify-scope.xlsx

If all good, the internal intake call is Tuesday June 27 10:00 PT. We will send a calendar invite and a brief M.A.P. (mutual action plan) beforehand.

Regards,
